description: This header defines cross-platform byte order manipulation functions such as ByteSwap, NetToHost, and HostToNet for 16, 32, and 64-bit values, handling endianness conversions and byte swapping.

methods.name: ByteSwap
methods.description: Swaps bytes for 16, 32, or 64-bit integers to reverse endianness.

methods.name: ByteSwapUintPtrT
methods.description: Byte swaps a uintptr_t value depending on its size (4 or 8 bytes).

methods.name: ByteSwapToLE16
methods.description: Converts 16-bit value from host to little endian.

methods.name: ByteSwapToLE32
methods.description: Converts 32-bit value from host to little endian.

methods.name: ByteSwapToLE64
methods.description: Converts 64-bit value from host to little endian.

methods.name: NetToHost16
methods.description: Converts 16-bit network order to host order.

methods.name: NetToHost32
methods.description: Converts 32-bit network order to host order.

methods.name: NetToHost64
methods.description: Converts 64-bit network order to host order.

methods.name: HostToNet16
methods.description: Converts 16-bit host order to network order.

methods.name: HostToNet32
methods.description: Converts 32-bit host order to network order.

methods.name: HostToNet64
methods.description: Converts 64-bit host order to network order.
